newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dutch say special ECOFIN not needed - EU sources.
newsitem.headline: Dutch say special ECOFIN not needed - EU sources.

text.p: The Dutch European Union presidency told EU diplomats on Thursday that a special meeting of finance ministers would not be needed at the weekend to deal with concerns over the budget stability pact, EU sources said.
"It was made explicitly clear by the Dutch...that there will be no ECOFIN on Saturday or Sunday," one diplomat said.

Speculation of an extraordinary ministerial meeting to resolve French demands over the budget pact has surfaced in the past few days, but diplomats said there was no formal need for the group to gather ahead of the EU summit on June 16 and 17.
Since the finance ministers will attend the summit, sources said their expertise could be called upon at any time during the two-day meeting if needed.
